title: Volatility-managed market factor momentum (Ken French daily MOM) with scale-down-only vol targeting and a high-market-vol gate
mechanism: Cash-and-overlay exposure to the Ken French daily momentum factor (MOM): hold weight w_t decided at the close of t-1, in [0,1], no leverage; collateral earns the T-bill. w_t = min(1, 0.06 / sigma126_ann(MOM)) scaled to 0 whenever trailing 126-day market volatility sits above its trailing 756-day median (T07). All inputs are factor returns; this is factor-spread research, not a directly tradable instrument: implementing it live requires a long- and short-side construction (ETFs, swaps, or factor futures) whose costs on the short leg are NOT captured here.

data_used.vintage: 2026-06 CRSP database; distributed as percent per day
data_used.license_note: Keyless academic bulk files; research with citation (manifest source_policies.ken_french)

data_used.vintage: 2026-06 CRSP database; six value-weight portfolios, prior return day -250 to -21, distributed as percent per day

development_window.note: Task-specific long history; supersedes contract default 2020-2024 for this family (recorded pre-results in trials.json). 1926-11-03..1929 warm-up consumed by 126d/756d lookbacks. Every selection decision used only data through 2009-12-31.

validation_window.one_frozen_comparison: T07 only; all other variants' validation metrics were never computed in wave one (parser caps at 2024-12-31 and validation mode simulates only dev-loop variants through a shared window, reporting only SELECTED).

embargo_handling.guard: run.py exits(2) when --end > 2024-12-31 unless QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1; the flag is never set during wave one and no selection or parameter logic depends on it.
embargo_handling.terminology: historical_confirmation per explorations/protocol-amendment.json (parameter-embargoed, not epistemically blind); untouched evidence begins with the prospective forward shadow 2026-08-29.

parameters.scaling: min(1, target / trailing_ann_vol); scale-down-only; floors at 0
parameters.market_vol_state: 126-day realized market vol vs its trailing 756-day median; high-vol state forces w=0
parameters.execution: weights determined from data through t-1; applied to day t factor and RF returns (next-bar, no same-day information)

signal_timing: End-of-day signal; Filled at next bar convention: position held during day t is a function of MOM/Mkt-RF/RF observations strictly before day t (lookback windows exclude day t itself; weights_for uses [i-126, i) and [i-756, i)).

cost_model.note: Cost is on the overlay rebalance weight change, not notional-pair turnover of an underlying stock portfolio; factor spreads internally rebalance continuously. This understates live implementation cost if the vehicle is a high-spread ETP; state flips are only 1.27/yr so the drag is small at the modeled level.

benchmark.primary: RF + MOM (always-on momentum, fully funded, zero turnover, no cost)
benchmark.why: Mandatory naive baseline for factor timing per protocol-amendment.json; also the dev/validation incumbent under test

metrics.subperiod_stability: Both validation halves: strategy Sharpe > benchmark Sharpe (0.75 vs 0.38; 1.41 vs 0.27) and maxDD < benchmark maxDD in both. No sign flip of benchmark excess in either half.

first_falsification_gate.definition: 1) Validation net Sharpe > benchmark net Sharpe; 2) cumulative validation excess return vs benchmark > 0 at 2x costs; 3) risk overlay clause: net maxDD < benchmark maxDD and realized net ann vol within 8% (vs 6% target, tolerance for estimator error); all must hold; trial budget <= 8.

leakage_checks.signal_excludes_current_day: Lookback windows [i-126,i) and [i-756,i) strictly exclude day i; position on day t derives only from data through t-1.
leakage_checks.selection_free_of_validation: SELECTED frozen in run.py from the 2009 dev-window ranking; validation was run once, afterwards.
leakage_checks.holdout_isolation: Parser rejects any observation past 2024-12-31 in wave one (fail-closed on --end > 20241231 without QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1); no embargoed date ever parsed, no embargoed metric computed or reported.
leakage_checks.no_survivorship_universe_issue: Factor time series only; no stock-level selection, no universe membership decisions.
leakage_checks.rf_units_verified: Percent-per-day parse confirmed by the 1981-1985 RF at ~10-13% annualized and zero-rate episodes matching published Ibbotson/ICE history; factor columns match published scales (Mkt-RF -2.78%..+1.81% per day in-sample extremes).
leakage_checks.no_lookahead_in_vol_estimator: sigma126 uses trailing completed 126 days; median756 uses trailing completed 756 days of mvol, itself trailing.
leakage_checks.no_selection_on_stress: 2x-cost stress applied identically in dev (informative only) and validation (gate); no re-pick after stress.
leakage_checks.no_embargo_leak: holdout_accessed=false; no file containing 2025+ observations opened for this research beyond byte-level checksum verification of raw zips.

risks: Implementation gap: MOM is a long-short research spread with continuous internal rebalancing; a tradable proxy (e.g., long/short ETF pair or factor futures) adds borrow, financing, and rebalancing costs not modeled; modeled cost drag (0.08%/yr) applies to the overlay only.

Selection bias: best of 8 correlated dev variants; a deflated-Sharpe haircut was not formally computed (needs bootstrap over the dev path); dev winner's validation Sharpe (0.99) already shows a 1.65 -> 0.99 degradation consistent with unbiased regression toward the mean - treat validation estimate as an upper bound on live performance.
Regime fragility: state gate (market vol above trailing 756d median) is a binary regime call; aggressive rate shifts could shift vol-state frequencies in ways unrepresentative of 1930-2024.

Momentum crash exposure is reduced but not eliminated: T07 holds full-on MOM only 1.8% of days; worst validation DD -7.1% vs benchmark -39.9%, but a crash during a low-vol regime could exceed historical DD.
Cost model: 5bps mght be too benign for ETP vehicle spreads in stress markets; 2x stress tested but a 10x-equivalent borrow/spread event would erase the 0.22 excess cumulatively over 15 years.

Vol targeting suppresses vol in high-vol states but keeps dry powder in low-vol entanglement with factor exposure - if MOM premium decays toward zero, vol-managed exposure can still underperform T-bills; 2018-2024 result (Sharpe 1.41) is above dev repeatability expectations and could reflect regime luck.
next_experiment: historical_confirmation (2025-01-01..2026-07-31) of frozen T07 by the separate evaluator under protocol-amendment.json statistics (block bootstrap, seeded 20260829, FDR/Holm across the single factor_timing candidate); if that fails, falsify rather than re-tune. Simultaneously, run a prospective forward shadow from 2026-08-29 in paper mode with T07 parameters unchanged.
